statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: apps/dashboard/src/components/forms/settings/form-api-key.tsx, apps/dashboard/src/components/forms/settings/form-api-key.test.tsx. Do not edit forbidden paths: packages/ui/src/components/ui/dialog*, packages/ui/src/components/ui/popover*, apps/dashboard/src/styles/**, apps/api/**, packages/db/**, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, apps/dashboard/src/components/forms/settings/** (except allowed paths).
